steps.description:
Tired of duplicating the blocks? Here's where Repeat loops will help. When solving a problem, you first observe the sequence, then identify repeating patterns. These patterns can then be repeated as a set of codes using Repeat loop.

A Repeat-times loop repeats a set of code a specific number of times.


Using a Repeat-times loop, make your robot play 5 beeping sounds.

Recall that you need to pause with a Wait block to make beeping sounds.

A Repeat-times loop repeats a set of code a specific number of times.


Programming is an excellent tool for creating and interpreting secret messages, or what we call encoding and decoding. Below is a simple exercise to interpret message using symbols.

A sound sequence is represented by the following symbols:

                          • _ • _ • _

Each • means play a sound for 0.1 second.
Each _ means play a sound for 0.4 second.
There is an interval of 0.2 second (wait) between the sounds.

Using Repeat-times loop, make your robot play the above sound sequence once.

Morse code is a legacy encoding system used in many areas such as military intelligence and emergency signalling.
         

The distress signal, SOS, is represented by the following Morse code:

                          • • • _ _ _ • • • 

You wanted to transmit this signal using sound.
Each • means play a sound for 0.1 second.
Each _ means play a sound for 0.4 second.
Timing is crucial in Morse code but to keep it simple, we will simply add an interval of 0.2 second (wait) between the sounds.

Using Repeat-times loops, make your robot perform an SOS beeping sequence.
You can use more than one loop.

The table below displays the symbols that represent each letter in International Morse Code.
    

You wanted to transmit the message "HIDE" to your special task force using sound.
Each • means play a sound for 0.1 second.
Each _ means play a sound for 0.4 second.
Timing is crucial in Morse code but to keep it simple, we will simply add an interval 0.2 second (wait) between the sounds.

Using Repeat-times loops, make your robot perform the beeping sequence for 3 times.

1. You can use more than one loop.
2. You can put a loop inside a loop. We call this nested loop.
